title: We Have Waited for Him
old_p1: Long ago, Isaiah, a prophet who spoke for Heavenly Father, said people would say, “This is the Lord; we have waited for Him, and He will save us.”
When the angels left, the shepherds said, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see!”
They hurried and found Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in a manger, a box for animals’ food. The One they had waited for was here!
old_p2: The shepherds told everyone about the baby, and all who heard were amazed. Mary kept it all in her heart. The scriptures say, “Heavenly Father so loved the world, that He gave His only Son.” Jesus was His gift to us!
Tonight, hug yourself tight. Jesus is Heavenly Father’s gift to you, because He loves you so.
p1: Long ago, Isaiah told what Heavenly Father said. One day people would say, “This is the Lord; we have waited for Him.” They would say, “He will save us!”
The night Jesus was born, the angels went back into heaven. The shepherds said, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see!”
They hurried and found Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in a manger. The One they had waited for was here!
p2: The shepherds told everyone about the baby, and all who heard were amazed. Mary kept these things in her heart. The shepherds went back praising Heavenly Father.
Jesus came because Heavenly Father loved the world so much, He gave His Son. Good news is for sharing! Tomorrow, tell someone, “Jesus is born!”
